candidate_relations.reason: Sarcoma is the correct malignant mesenchymal family but omits leiomyosarcoma.
Phyllodes tumor is a fibroepithelial neoplasm, not leiomyosarcoma.
A growing, muscle-fixed post-radiation mass is not a lipoma.
Primary breast sarcoma is a parent of leiomyosarcoma and does not specify smooth-muscle histology (and may underplay radiation association).
The original carcinoma was upper-inner quadrant; this new lower-outer, muscle-fixed mass 6 years after radiation is not recurrent carcinoma of that site.

case_quality_flags: Post-radiation new mass in a different quadrant 6 years after carcinoma; core biopsy was nondiagnostic. No candidate names leiomyosarcoma.
